verdict.rationale: The only booking-related evidence is a pricing-page line listing "Appointment booking pages". Nothing documents embedding that booking experience in a developer's own site, whether inline, popup or floating widget, and no embed snippet is shown. The API docs cover calendar and event REST operations, not an embeddable booking widget.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the booking experience in my own site — inline, popup, or floating widget — with a documented snippet
